Harare Metropolitan Province since c.1997; earlier rows refer to Harare (Salisbury) city, reported separately, wholly inside the current province (which also includes Chitungwiza and Epworth).

Legally Harare/Chitungwiza were in Mashonaland East and Bulawayo in Matabeleland North until c.1997, but health reporting listed Harare and Bulawayo cities separately (e.g. MoHCW 1993 provincial table) and the dataset carries concurrent Harare/Bulawayo rows, so no era shift is applied (shifting would double-count).

Source mislabel: both rows (2015) are Beitbridge District, which is in Matabeleland South; no Mashonaland South province has existed since the early-1980s reorganisation (the historical Mashonaland South became Mashonaland East + part of Mashonaland West). If pre-1983 data ever appear under this name they are a legacy split unit, not Matabeleland South.
